title: Supramolecular organization by reversible recognition
statement: A supramolecular whole is a finite assembly of multiple intact molecular carriers joined by reversible complementary recognition support, with all components recoverable.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the registered supramolecular components, joining, recognition, reversal, closure, scope, record and extension choices.
grammar_boundary: Every finite assembly of multiple complete molecular carriers joined through reversible recognition support, with all components recoverable and the collective whole separately distinguishable.

choices.name: single-molecule-only
choices.reason: A supramolecular assembly contains multiple molecular components.

choices.name: new-internal-covalent-graph
choices.reason: Replacing components by one covalent graph erases the supramolecular boundary.

choices.name: noncovalent-interaction-support
choices.reason: Between-component channels join intact molecular wholes.

choices.name: arbitrary-collision
choices.reason: A collision has no complementary selection trace.

choices.name: complementary-recognition
choices.reason: Matched held labels select joining partners.

choices.name: components-unrecoverable
choices.reason: If components cannot be recovered, their identities were not retained.

choices.name: reversible-component-release
choices.reason: Opening channels recovers each named molecular carrier.

choices.name: components-only
choices.reason: Separate components do not form an assembled whole.

choices.name: assembled-whole-identity
choices.reason: The collective recurrence is independently distinguishable.

choices.name: completed-infinite-assembly
choices.reason: A completed infinity is not generated.

choices.name: finite-declared-assembly
choices.reason: Every component and interaction is enumerated.

choices.name: assembly-name-only
choices.reason: A name cannot reconstruct recognition and release.

choices.name: component-recognition-trace
choices.reason: Components, channels, reversals and closure remain held.

choices.name: free-host-guest-rule
choices.reason: An exception can force any desired assembly.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: Reversible complementary support supplies the class.

induction_base: Two intact molecular carriers with one complementary reversible recognition channel supply the first supramolecular whole.
induction_step: Appending one recognized component retains every earlier identity and channel and preserves exact release reconstruction of the enlarged finite assembly.
exclusions: no chemical dictionary, coordinate archive, fitted force field, measured geometry or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no application or opaque prediction result
no claim that topology alone predicts every measured coordinate or energy
external content remains inaccessible until after the consequence is sealed
Every finite assembly of multiple complete molecular carriers joined through reversible recognition support, with all components recoverable and the collective whole separately distinguishable.
operational_witnesses: one complementary channel joins host and guest
both intact component identities remain recoverable
opening the retained channel recovers both registered components
falsification_condition: The claim fails if the official supramolecular record lacks multiple molecular components, noncovalent organization or retained component identities, or if a changed row is accepted.
